name: National Hockey League
notes: the league root; every season 1917-18 on (no 2004-05 season)

name: Prince of Wales Conference
notes: lineage: the Prince of Wales Conference (1974-75 to 1992-93) was renamed the Eastern Conference in 1993-94, so one id spans both; ESPN group 7 also spans the change

name: Eastern Conference
notes: api-web abbreviates it XVE until 2012-13 and E from 2013-14; no conferences in 2020-21

name: Clarence Campbell Conference
notes: lineage: the Clarence Campbell Conference (1974-75 to 1992-93) was renamed the Western Conference in 1993-94, so one id spans both; ESPN group 8 also spans the change

name: Western Conference
notes: api-web abbreviates it XVW until 2012-13 and W from 2013-14; no conferences in 2020-21

name: Canadian Division
notes: the league's first two-division split, 1926-27 to 1937-38, with no conferences; single table before and after

name: American Division
notes: 1926-27 to 1937-38, with no conferences

name: East Division
notes: the 1967 expansion split, 1967-68 to 1973-74, with no conferences; a new body, unrelated to the later Eastern Conference

name: West Division
notes: 1967-68 to 1973-74 (the expansion teams), with no conferences; a new body, unrelated to the later Western Conference

name: Adams Division
notes: lineage: Adams (1974-75 to 1992-93) renamed Northeast in 1993-94, ended by the 2013-14 realignment. Membership carries over (1992-93 Adams BOS BUF HFD MTL OTT QUE; 1993-94 Northeast adds PIT)

name: Patrick Division
notes: lineage: Patrick (1974-75 to 1992-93) renamed Atlantic in 1993-94, ended by the 2013-14 realignment; not the 2013 Atlantic (nhl:atlantic). In the Campbell Conference to 1980-81 and the Wales Conference from 1981-82

name: Norris Division
notes: lineage: Norris (1974-75 to 1992-93) renamed Central in 1993-94, ended by the 2013-14 realignment; not the 2013 Central (nhl:central). In the Wales Conference to 1980-81 and the Campbell Conference from 1981-82

name: Smythe Division
notes: lineage: Smythe (1974-75 to 1992-93) renamed Pacific in 1993-94, ended by the 2013-14 realignment; not the 2013 Pacific (nhl:pacific)

name: Southeast Division
notes: new in the 1998-99 six-division alignment; ended by the 2013-14 realignment

name: Northwest Division
notes: new in the 1998-99 six-division alignment; ended by the 2013-14 realignment

name: Atlantic Division
notes: lineage: the 2013-14 realignment made four new divisions. ESPN minted new ids for all four (30-33; its pre-2013 Pacific was 5) and api-web changed every abbreviation, so they are new bodies even where a name was reused: this Atlantic took five of the old Northeast's teams and none of the old Atlantic's. Suspended for the 2020-21 temporary divisions

name: Metropolitan Division
notes: new in 2013-14 (see nhl:atlantic); took the old Atlantic's five teams plus CAR, WSH and CBJ. Suspended for 2020-21

name: Central Division
notes: new in 2013-14 (see nhl:atlantic). Suspended for 2020-21

name: Pacific Division
notes: new in 2013-14 (see nhl:atlantic). Suspended for 2020-21

name: MassMutual East Division
notes: 2020-21 only: four temporary, sponsor-named, geography-driven divisions (the Canada-US border closure) with no conferences; ESPN has no groups at all for 2021

name: Discover Central Division
notes: 2020-21 only (see nhl:east-2021); shares the abbreviation CEN with the 1993-2013 Central, so the match key is (name, abbreviation)

name: Honda West Division
notes: 2020-21 only (see nhl:east-2021)

name: Scotia North Division
notes: 2020-21 only (see nhl:east-2021): the seven Canadian teams
